title: Entitlement gap analysis and cutover playbook for SKU & limit restructure
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Scope: Prepare and execute the cross-functional cutover for the SKU and limits reorganization impacting hosted and dedicated customers. Deliverables: 1) entitlement mapping table and migration scripts, 2) billing enforcement rules and grace-period logic, 3) Console UI copy + telemetry changes, 4) customer-facing comms and release notes, 5) sales & support enablement pack, 6) rollback & mitigation runbook. Out of scope: backend pricing engine rewrite (separate initiative). Goals: minimize bill surprises, keep <0.5% of active customers in manual adjustments, and ensure SLOs for checkout and role-based access during migration. Assumptions: engineering will deliver migration API by 2025-02-10, billing team will accept sampled invoices for QA, legal will approve comms templates by 2025-02-07.
acceptance_criteria: Entitlement mapping validated for top 200 accounts by spend
Migration script ran successfully in staging with no invoice divergences >0.5%
Console shows new SKU labels and limits with correct per-tenant overrides
Release notes and billing FAQ published and approved by legal and support
Sales enablement materials completed and at least two training sessions scheduled
Rollback plan tested end-to-end in staging and documented in runbook

notes_for_release_notes: Public release: SKU and limits restructuring to simplify pricing tiers, reduce surprising overages, and enable per-tenant flexibility. Customers may see renamed SKUs and updated limits; no immediate invoice increases expected for the majority of customers. Enterprise customers with Dedicated plans will receive separate notices and a 30-day transition window. Internal: include example scenarios and migration FAQ link.
post_launch_metrics: support ticket volume for pricing questions
